1.w: [“] And in the seventh month, on the first of the month, you⁺ shall have a holy convocation; you⁺ shall not do any customary work. It is a day of sounding for you⁺.

2.w: And you⁺ shall offer a burnt offering, a pleasing aroma to YHWH: One bull, a son of the herd, one ram, [and] seven lambs, sons of a year, unblemished,

3.w: and their grain offerings of fine flour mixed with the oil, three tenths [of an ephah] for the bull, two tenths for the ram,

4.w: and one tenth for the one lamb, for the seven lambs,

5.w: and one kid of the goats [as] a sin offering, to make atonement upon you⁺,

6.w: besides the burnt offering with the New Moon and its grain offering, and the regular burnt offering and its grain offering, and their drink offerings, according to their ordinance, a pleasing aroma, a fire offering to YHWH.

7.w: And on the tenth of this seventh month, you⁺ shall have a holy convocation, and you⁺ shall afflict your⁺ souls; you⁺ shall not do any work.

8.w: And you⁺ shall present a burnt offering to YHWH, a pleasing aroma: One bull, a son of the herd, one ram, [and] seven lambs, sons of a year; they are unblemished for you⁺,

9.w: and their grain offerings of fine flour mixed with the oil, three tenths [of an ephah] for the bull, two tenths for the one ram,

10.w: [and] a tenth part [of an ephah] for the one lamb, for the seven lambs,

11.w: one kid of the goats [as] a sin offering, besides the sin offering for atonement, and the regular burnt offering and its grain offering, and their drink offerings.

12.w: And on the fifteenth day of the seventh month you⁺ shall have a holy convocation; you⁺ shall not do any customary work. And you⁺ shall keep a feast to YHWH seven days.

13.w: And you⁺ shall present a burnt offering, a fire offering, a pleasing aroma to YHWH, thirteen bulls, sons of the herd, two rams, [and] fourteen lambs, sons of a year; they shall be unblemished;

14.w: and their grain offerings of fine flour mixed with the oil, three tenths [of an ephah] for the one bull, for the thirteen bulls, two tenths for the one ram, for the two rams,

15.w: [and] a tenth part [of an ephah] for the one lamb, for the fourteen lambs,

16.w: and one kid of the goats [as] a sin offering, besides the regular burnt offering, its grain offering, and its drink offering.

17.w: And on the second day: Twelve bulls, sons of the herd, two rams, fourteen lambs, sons of a year, unblemished,

18.w: and their grain offerings and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, by their number, according to the ordinance,

19.w: and one kid of the goats [as] a sin offering, besides the regular burnt offering, and its grain offering, and their drink offerings.

20.w: And on the third day: Eleven bulls, two rams, fourteen lambs, sons of a year, unblemished,

21.w: and their grain offerings and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, by their number, according to the ordinance,

22.w: and one goat [as] a sin offering, besides the regular burnt offering, and its grain offering, and its drink offering.

23.w: And on the fourth day: Ten bulls, two rams, fourteen lambs, sons of a year, unblemished,

24.w: and their grain offerings and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, by their number, according to the ordinance,

25.w: and one kid of the goats [as] a sin offering, besides the regular burnt offering, its grain offering, and its drink offering.

26.w: And on the fifth day: Nine bulls, two rams, [and] fourteen lambs, sons of a year, unblemished,

27.w: and their grain offerings and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, by their number, according to the ordinance,

28.w: and one goat [as] a sin offering, besides the regular burnt offering, and its grain offering, and its drink offering.

29.w: And on the sixth day: Eight bulls, two rams, [and] fourteen lambs, sons of a year, unblemished,

30.w: and their grain offerings and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, by their number, according to the ordinance,

31.w: and one goat [as] a sin offering, besides the regular burnt offering, its grain offering, and its drink offerings.

32.w: And on the seventh day: Seven bulls, two rams, fourteen lambs, sons of a year, unblemished,

33.w: and their grain offerings and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, by their number, according to the ordinance,

34.w: and one goat [as] a sin offering, besides the regular burnt offering, its grain offering, and its drink offering.

35.w: On the eighth day you⁺ shall have a sacred assembly; you⁺ shall not do any customary work.

36.w: And you⁺ shall present a burnt offering, a fire offering, a pleasing aroma to YHWH: One bull, one ram, seven lambs, sons of a year, unblemished,

37.w: and their grain offerings, and their drink offerings, for the bull, for the ram, and for the lambs, by their number, according to the ordinance,

38.w: and one goat [as] a sin offering, besides the regular burnt offering, and its grain offering, and its drink offering.

39.w: These you⁺ shall present to YHWH at your⁺ appointed feasts, in addition to your⁺ vows and your⁺ freewill offerings, as your⁺ burnt offerings, and your⁺ grain offerings, and as your⁺ drink offerings, and your⁺ peace offerings.”

40.w: And Moses spoke to the sons of Israel according to all that YHWH had commanded Moses.
